text:
Evan T.: Heads-up — AB ratecard canary flipped at 2026-07-12T15:00Z. Seeing ~42 accounts in cohort-B charged new per-unit fees even though their accounts have grandfather_tag=true. Spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/finance/ab-ratecanary (view).

Nadia R.: which service applied the routing? rate-applier v2 or the new unified pricer v1?

Evan T.: rollout used pricer v1. It looks like the legacy grandfather check ran but mismatched on account.tenancy_id vs billing_account_id.

Priya G.: quick log snippet: 
```
2026-07-12T15:01:03Z WARN grandfather_check miss for acct=acc_778 tenancy=null
2026-07-12T15:01:04Z INFO apply_price(account=acc_778, cohort=B)
```

Billing Ops: any invoices yet? If within 30 days we can issue credits, >30 days requires Legal sign-off.

finance-bot: Billing scan: 42 accounts flagged; 11 invoices generated between 2026-07-12 and 2026-07-13. Audit id: https://ops.redwood/audit/FIN-5112.

Nadia R.: root cause appears to be pricer v1 defaulting tenancy lookup to request.owner_id when tenancy header missing. Patch proposal: require explicit billing_account_id in request and fail-safe to hold for manual review. Patch: 
```
- tenancy_lookup: request.owner_id || null
+ tenancy_lookup: request.billing_account_id || fail_review_queue
```

Priya G.: agreed. Immediate actions: 1) PAUSE cohort B rollout, 2) rollback pricer v1 to traffic=0, 3) run reverse-credit job for impacted invoices <30d, 4) prepare credit memos for customers. Tagging Legal for memos >$3k.

Legal: note — for mass automated memos include opt-out link and reference T&C section 4.2. For credits >$3k need VP Finance approval.

Billing Ops: we'll prepare memo template and pre-approve up to $3k. Anything above we route via FIN-5112. Also collect AM owners.

ops-bot: Dry-run reverse-credit on sample(100): 9 mismatches found, checksum 4f3d2b. Scheduled full run in 30m pending rollback.

Evan T.: assigning owners: Nadia -> hotfix & rollback; Priya -> invoice list + communications; Billing Ops -> memos & AM list; Legal -> approval path. I'll update the release board and pause rollout.

finance-bot: FIN ticket created FIN-5112 with rollback steps and links. Please post results in ticket when done.

Priya G.: thanks. After fix we'll re-run canary with an extra preflight: require billing_account_id present and vendor-feed freshness check. Will follow up with a short postmortem once resolved. :thumbsup:
